_doc: Layer inventory for the Genome Atlas. Round 1 stubs all planned layers as not-yet-implemented entries so the engine can boot and the [data-ga-layer] chips have a registry to look up. Each layer's `tier` / `source` / `path` is the COMMITTED contract per SCHEMA §28; the actual files don't exist yet — they ship from the cluster-side genome-annotation pipeline (phase B+). Layers carrying `_optional: true` are facultative: when absent, the consuming page hides the corresponding panel rather than erroring.

_tier_legend.hot: RAM-pinned at trigger event; pages read state directly; <1ms
_tier_legend.warm: IndexedDB-cached at trigger event; first read async ~50ms; subsequent ~10ms

_round1_status: All fourteen layers are CONTRACT-ONLY (not-yet-loaded). page_scaffold's scaffold renders them as '⚪ not loaded' chips. Phase B turns on chromosome_map + gene_track + repeat_track + crossover_track (the last drives the new page_chromosome_overview CO-density sub-track too). Phase C turns on prdm9_motif (facultative, page_crossovers) + nco_gc_track (primary on page_nco_gc). Phase D turns on synteny_blocks + synteny_oxford_grid (page_synteny ribbon + macrosyntR-style Oxford-grid views) + ortholog_tables (page_orthologues summary + per-chrom) + ortholog_pairs (page_orthologues View 3, lazy). Layers carrying `_optional: true` are facultative — the consuming page hides the corresponding panel rather than erroring.

assembly_stats._feeds: page_scaffold chromosome overview · QC banner (phase B)

gene_track._feeds: gene cargo per inversion · functional context (phase B/C)

repeat_track._feeds: TE landscape · breakpoint repeat enrichment (phase B)

te_hierarchy._feeds: page6 View 4 — TE-hierarchy alluvial (per parental haplotype, N-level)
te_hierarchy._source_pipeline: RepeatMasker / EDTA post-processing — aggregate bp per (haplotype, repeat, te_category, class, order, family) tree per Wicker et al. 2007
te_hierarchy._schema: { haplotypes: [ { id, name, label, column_headers?, nodes: [<node>] } ] }; <node> = { id, name, pct, palette?, children?: [<node>] }. pct = % of total genome; children sum ≤ parent.pct. Legacy { total_bp, classes:[...] } shape is auto-adapted by the renderer.

synteny_blocks._feeds: collinearity vs related Siluriformes · ancestral karyotype (phase D)

macrosynteny_orthologs._feeds: page9 View 3 — MacrosyntR-style Oxford macro-synteny grid (and linear macro-synteny in later rounds)
macrosynteny_orthologs._source_pipeline: OrthoFinder + BUSCO single-copy orthologs (or wfmash 1-to-1 alignments distilled to gene-anchor positions) — one JSON per species pair
macrosynteny_orthologs._schema: { pairs: [{ id, name, x: { id, name, chroms: [{ id, name, length_bp }] }, y: {…}, orthologs: [{ xc, xp, yc, yp }] }] }; positions in bp

centromere_telomere._feeds: centromere bands · T2T completeness chip (phase B)

crossover_track._path_doc: Per-inversion-candidate file. The renderer interpolates `candidate_id` from shared.candidate; the layer registry never enumerates the directory.
crossover_track._feeds: page_crossovers sex-specific CO ideogram + CO-rate-vs-telomere-distance curve (phase C); page_chromosome_overview CO-density sub-track on the chromosome strip (sex-collapsed, summarised across all candidates)
crossover_track._schema: see page_crossovers spec — { candidate_id, candidate_span{chrom,start_bp,end_bp}, flank_bp?, events[{chrom,pos_bp,sex,indiv?,in_span?}], telomere_curve?, curve_params? }

prdm9_motif._path_doc: Embedded as `prdm9_motif` on the same per-candidate crossover JSON — no separate file. The pointer here is kept for the layers-registry chip.
prdm9_motif._feeds: page_crossovers sequence-logo card — auto-hidden when pwm is null/missing
prdm9_motif._source_pipeline: MEME / STREME on CO ±2 kb hotspots in the candidate flank
prdm9_motif._schema: { pwm: N×4 ACGT PWM | null, tool, evalue, n_hotspots }

nco_gc_track._path_doc: Per-inversion-candidate file. Separate from crossover_track because the pedigree NCO/GC detector emits a distinct table.
nco_gc_track._feeds: page_nco_gc tract ideogram + tract-rate-vs-telomere-distance curves (NCO green / GC yellow)
nco_gc_track._schema: see page_nco_gc spec — { candidate_id, candidate_span{chrom,start_bp,end_bp}, flank_bp?, tracts[{chrom,start_bp,end_bp,kind∈nco|gc,indiv?,in_span?}], telomere_curve?, curve_params? }

synteny_oxford_grid._path_doc: Per ordered focal pair (genome A × genome B). Renderer fetches the file matching the active selection from the page_synteny toggle; never enumerates the directory.
synteny_oxford_grid._feeds: page_synteny View 4 — macrosyntR-style Oxford grid (aggregated; one dot per chrom-pair, sized by ortholog count, coloured by BH-q)
synteny_oxford_grid._source_pipeline: OrthoFinder → macrosyntR (SamiLhll/macrosyntR) chrom-pair Fisher exact + BH
synteny_oxford_grid._schema: see page_synteny spec — { pair_id, method, ortholog_source, genome_a{id,label,chroms[]}, genome_b{...}, cells[{chrom_a,chrom_b,n_orthologs,fisher_p?,fisher_q?,significant?}], thresholds?{q_hi,q_lo} }

ortholog_tables._path_doc: One file per focal genome. Renderer interpolates focal_id from shared.focalGenome (set on page_orthologues, mirrored from page_synteny Oxford grid).
ortholog_tables._feeds: page_orthologues Views 1 + 2 — focal × non-focal summary table and per focal-chrom %1:1 breakdown

ortholog_pairs._path_doc: Per (focal, non-focal) pair. Lazy-loaded on column reveal in page_orthologues View 3; never fetched if View 3 stays collapsed.
ortholog_pairs._feeds: page_orthologues View 3 — gene-level explorer (one column per non-focal, hydrated on reveal)

te_abundance._source_pipeline: EDTA + RepeatMasker per species (Chapter 5 module step 04)

kimura_landscape._source_pipeline: RepeatMasker divsum per species (Chapter 5 module step 02)

centromeres_cgar._source_pipeline: quarTeT / centromics on Cgar RefSeq (Chapter 5 module step 04)

breakpoint_te_cross._feeds: page_comparative_te V5 · Inversion Atlas page16 (breakpoint badge)
